en.headline: Regulators pick 36 agentic AI pilots for expanded finance sandbox
en.dek: HKMA, the SFC, the Insurance Authority and the MPFA selected 36 use cases from nearly 100 proposals, involving 30 financial institutions and 27 technology partners.
body: Hong Kong’s financial regulators on Thursday named the first cohort of the expanded Generative Artificial Intelligence Sandbox++, selecting 36 use cases from nearly 100 proposals. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, the Insurance Authority and the Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority made the announcement with the Hong Kong Cyberport Management Company.

The cohort involves 30 financial institutions and 27 technology partners. Officials said the proposals were ranked on innovation, technical complexity and potential value to the industry, with advice from a selection committee of academic experts. Participants include banks, insurers, securities firms, MPF trustees and stored-value operators such as Ant Bank (Hong Kong), WeChat Pay Hong Kong and HSBC Life (International).

This round focuses on agentic artificial intelligence — systems that can carry out tasks with a greater degree of autonomy than content-generating tools. Trials will cover end-to-end processes including customer onboarding, payments, insurance claims and customer interactions, and will also test how one AI system can oversee the actions of another.

Participants will be onboarded to a platform managed by Cyberport’s Artificial Intelligence Supercomputing Centre, with technical trials due to start later this year. The authorities said taking part in the sandbox does not by itself amount to regulatory approval for commercial use. HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue said the partnerships were intended to unlock the potential of agentic AI and strengthen Hong Kong’s position as an international financial centre and innovation hub.

zh.headline: 金管局等公布首期GenA.I.沙盒++ 36個用例入選
zh.dek: 金管局、證監會、保監局及積金局聯同數碼港選出36個用例，來自近100份方案，涉及30家金融機構及27家技術夥伴。
body: 香港金融管理局、證券及期貨事務監察委員會、保險業監管局及強制性公積金計劃管理局，聯同香港數碼港管理有限公司周四公布，第一期「生成式人工智能（GenA.I.）沙盒++」已選出36個用例，來自近100份建議方案。
入選項目涉及30家金融機構及27家技術合作夥伴。當局表示，方案按創新性、技術複雜程度及對業界的潛在價值排序，並參考由學術界專家組成的評選委員會意見。參與機構包括銀行、保險公司、證券行、強積金受託人及儲值支付營運商，當中有螞蟻銀行（香港）、WeChat Pay Hong Kong及匯豐人壽等。
今期重點探討代理式人工智能（Agentic A.I.）應用，測試範圍超越內容生成，涵蓋客戶開戶、支付、保險理賠及客戶互動等完整流程，並會檢視如何以人工智能動態監察其他人工智能系統的操作。
參與者將進駐數碼港人工智能超算中心的指定平台，預計今年稍後展開技術測試。當局指出，參與沙盒本身並不代表有關系統已獲准作商業應用。金管局總裁余偉文表示，有關合作有助釋放代理式人工智能的潛力，鞏固香港作為國際金融中心及創新樞紐的地位。
